title: Norm Enforcement with a Soft Touch: Faster Emergence, Happier Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on the emergence and enforcement of social norms in multiagent systems. It models 'normative reasoning' and evaluates how agents learn and adhere to social rules (prohibitions and commitments) through different types of social communication. This study of norms and normative behavior is a core component of ethics and moral governance within artificial societies.
